description: This is a Python test script that verifies the reusability of SDK MQTT clients by running concurrent publisher and subscriber threads, connecting, publishing, subscribing, and verifying message exchange.

classes.name: ClientTwins
classes.description: A class managing a pair of MQTT clients (publisher and subscriber), handling their connection, message publishing, subscribing, and verification.

methods.name: run_publisher
methods.description: Runs the publisher thread, connecting, publishing messages, and disconnecting in a loop.

methods.name: run_subscriber
methods.description: Runs the subscriber thread, subscribing to a topic and counting incoming messages.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies that the messages sent and received match, ensuring reusability of the MQTT client.
